Location_Metadata.Description: A massive orbital junkyard built from welded ship carcasses, drifting asteroids, and broken stations. It is home to scavenger clans who live among the debris, crafting survival from the discarded bones of the galaxy.

Global_Geography.Lore: Entire sectors of the nest are stitched together from derelict battleships.
An asteroid core serves as the central anchor point for the entire structure.
Zero-gravity fields make navigation unpredictable and hazardous.
Tunnels and corridors shift constantly as hulls collapse or drift.
Scavenger huts are patched from alloy scraps, sails of shredded solar panels.
Air is recycled through ancient scrubbers salvaged from dozens of wrecks.
Radiation pockets linger in collapsed reactor zones, glowing ominously.

Geopolitics.Lore: The **Clans of Rust** govern through loose alliances and constant betrayal.
The **Core Syndicate** tolerates the Nest for cheap salvage, but demands tribute.
Pirates use the Nest as a hidden port for refits and resupply.
Smugglers trade rare scrap for black-market goods in its shifting alleys.
The **Scrapborn Children**, raised entirely in zero-g, form an independent faction.
Occasionally, rogue AI fragments are discovered and bartered like currency.
Rumors suggest an ancient Syndicate superweapon core lies hidden deep within the Nest.

Quest_Locales.Lore: The **Asteroid Core Market**, bustling with trade in scavenged parts.
The **Broken Fleet Yard**, a graveyard of battleships where radiation glows.
The **Zero-G Warrens**, a chaotic maze inhabited by Scrapborn Children.
The **Dark Reactor Hollow**, home to glowing, unstable cores.
The **Clans of Rust Council Ring**, where leaders argue amid junk heaps.
The **Hidden Pirate Dock**, concealed behind asteroid shielding.
The **Scrapfire Pits**, where old alloys are melted down for reuse.

Archetypes.Lore: **Chief Varrik**, ruthless leader of the dominant Rust Clan.
**Sela Drift**, Scrapborn child, nimble and feral, worshipped as a prophet.
**Jokar Wren**, merchant-smuggler with ties to Syndicate black markets.
**Talon Reeve**, pirate captain using the Nest as a covert base.
**Elda Mourn**, scavenger medic stitching survivors with whatever scraps fit.
**AI Fragment 17-Theta**, unstable but revered as an oracle of the junk.
**Korran Dusk**, exile engineer who knows the Nest’s hidden weapon secrets.

Quirks.Lore: Chief Varrik adorns himself with trophies made from ship plating.
Sela Drift speaks in riddles, mimicking radio interference.
Jokar Wren wears a necklace of data-chips, each one a debt owed.
Talon Reeve replaces his crew constantly, discarding them like junk.
Elda Mourn uses bones and alloy shards to splint broken limbs.
AI 17-Theta flickers through old ship voices when it speaks.
Korran Dusk never stops tinkering, building machines from garbage.

Quests.Lore: Help Chief Varrik consolidate power by eliminating rival clans.
Assist Sela Drift in deciphering a prophecy written in static patterns.
Smuggle rare salvage to Syndicate buyers via Jokar Wren’s routes.
Talon Reeve wants a warship rebuilt from wreckage—fast.
Retrieve rare med-tech for Elda Mourn from a collapsed battleship.
Interface with AI Fragment 17-Theta without going insane.
Uncover Korran Dusk’s secret and decide whether to aid or expose him.

Main_Plot_Points.Lore: The Scavenger’s Nest holds a long-lost Syndicate prototype weapon.
The clans risk civil war, threatening to tear the Nest apart.
Pirate activity could draw Core Syndicate military intervention.
The Scrapborn Children seek independence and recognition as a new people.
AI Fragment 17-Theta may contain hidden Syndicate directives.
Radiation pockets are spreading, threatening the habitat’s survival.
The Nest is on the brink of collapse—its fate could redefine scavenger culture forever.

Side_Quests.Lore: Rescue a lost clan child from the reactor hollow.
Recover a pirate’s stolen treasure hidden in the Zero-G Warrens.
Trade rare scrap to unlock access to the Hidden Pirate Dock.
Investigate a derelict ship that recently drifted into the Nest.
Deliver medical supplies to Elda Mourn before an epidemic spreads.
Uncover whether the clans are secretly harboring Syndicate fugitives.
Decide the fate of AI Fragment 17-Theta—liberation, destruction, or exploitation.

Story_Drivers.Lore: The Nest embodies survival at the edge of collapse.
Power struggles threaten to destabilize the fragile ecosystem.
The hidden weapon could shift galactic power balances.
The Scrapborn’s emergence may alter political recognition in the galaxy.
Player choices determine whether the Nest thrives or falls into ruin.
Corruption, piracy, and survivalist ingenuity define its essence.
The Nest may evolve into a beacon of independence—or vanish as forgotten junk.
